phases.name: Foundations
phases.focus: Establish movement patterns and baseline strength with bodyweight and minimal equipment.

phases.name: Progression
phases.focus: Increase work capacity and introduce progression for primary lifts using bodyweight and doorway bar.

phases.name: Consolidation
phases.focus: Solidify technique, improve relative strength, and prep for higher-intensity work.

phases.name: Peak/Return Load
phases.focus: Capstone phase to maximize strength within space/equipment constraints and plan for maintenance.

non_negotiables: Safety first: perform warm-up prior to each session.
Complete movements within available space in a small flat.
Use a doorway pull-up bar only; no other external equipment.
Maintain neutral spine; avoid rounding during loaded positions.
Progression must be controlled; focus on technique before load/volume.
If pain or discomfort occurs, stop and reassess form; seek guidance.
Rest days distributed; ensure 1–2 days of recovery per week.

PLAN "12-Week Doorway-Only Strength Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Full-body strength development for beginner, doorway-only, 4-day/week with safety-first progression"
PHASES
  PHASE "Foundations" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Push training 60m "Foundations Push 1":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
          mobility 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_pushup (on floor or step) 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Pull training 60m "Foundations Pull 1":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5m
          band_row (no equipment, use towel) 5m
        main straight_sets:
          inverted_row 3x6 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          door_pullup_hold 3x15s rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2m
          spinal_twist 1m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Leg/Core training 60m "Foundations Legs/Core 1":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
          hip_mgc 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          lunge_step_back 3x6 per leg rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x20s rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Accessibility/Recovery 40m "Foundations Access/Recovery 1":
        warmup:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x8 per side rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 per side rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
